subsystem.name: UIPlatformAndOptions
subsystem.responsibility: UI definition parsing (layers, elements, action commands), widget construction by keyword, UI registry lookup, session-mode page dispatch, game window lifecycle, game file path construction, HUD warning composition, texture variant loading, and oscillation sample generation.

summary: Evidence-linked reconstruction of the UI platform and options subsystem. A shared parser controller (UIElementParser) consumes token streams through a per-iteration token reader, constructs layer objects and tree nodes, binds surfaces, gizmos and pages, and appends typed action-command nodes to event chains. A keyword-driven widget factory builds 23 widget types by name. Registry lookup, session-mode page dispatch, the Win32 game window lifecycle, player/settings path construction, HUD warning-icon composition, texture-variant loading and an oscillation sample list builder complete the cluster. Ownership of the parser controller and every concrete widget type is not proven by the packet; class names and responsibilities are DERIVED or GUESS proposals.

function_roles.role: Parses a UI layer definition: classifies the layer name against normal/modal, constructs the matching layer object (188 bytes), links it into the layer list, and dispatches child tokens (name, sound focus/lost focus, gizmo, page) to element, texture and gizmo handlers.
Parses a stream of UI element configuration tokens (name, enter/escape target, location, posWH, location2, surface, gizmo) and builds them into a tree node registered with the owning tree.

Parses UI action commands from a token stream: matches command keywords (DoPage 1, DoPageTransition 2..6, TransitionAttr, DoLayer 7, SetSymbol 9, DropPopups 10, ExitGame 11, SimulateClick 12), tags 28-byte nodes, and appends them to the event action chain selected by the Click/Release/Focus/Lostfocus trigger keyword.

Builds a resource file path into a 256-byte buffer by repeating directory prefixes based on the parser nesting depth and appending the filename, and optionally writes the assembled path to the parser write stream.

Finds an existing UI widget by name through the child container vtable or, on a miss, scans the 23-entry keyword table and dispatches the matched index through a jump table to a per-type constructor; applies a prelink-gizmo label to newly created widgets.
Reads two DWORD fields at the global render-device object (offsets +28 and +32) into caller output pointers and returns the global pointer.
Searches a two-level nested linked list by name: walks outer list nodes, retrieves inner list heads, and compares the inner item name at byte offset 52, returning the last matching item.
Dispatches a UI page lookup based on the session mode value: modes 1..4 open the monitor page, mode 5 opens the multiplayer host or client grid page depending on a module-manager state check.

Creates the main game window: formats a title from the game name and version, fills and registers WNDCLASSEX structs for the cube-realtime class and an optional message-window class, creates the windows, clips the cursor and shows the window.
Destroys up to two windows and unregisters their window classes at shutdown, guarding against a double-destroy when both handles are equal, then releases the cursor clip.
Builds a full player file path in a caller buffer: copies and re-appends the source name and appends the '.PLR' extension; used by the file-copy dispatch and text-file reader paths.

Rebuilds a target list by transferring every node of a source list: searches, unlinks, optionally frees the node data buffer, and prepends a fresh 12-byte node carrying the same data pointer to the target list.
Builds a file path by selecting the current directory (falling back to the default application path), copying it with reallocation, and appending the '.vcr' extension.
Composes a HUD warning-icon string from three warning conditions and renders it with scale when any warning is active.
Iterates an array of sub-elements on the receiver and dispatches a float value to each element, returning the element count.

Builds up to four texture-variant paths with a letter suffix (splitting the base name from its extension, defaulting the extension, stripping a trailing A..D letter) and submits each variant to the texture adjuster.
Rebuilds a linked list of oscillation samples from clamped random-noise and sinusoidal motion, terminating when the accumulated time exceeds the threshold.

classes.name: UIElementParser
classes.responsibility: Parses UI definition and command token streams: constructs layer objects and tree nodes, binds surfaces/gizmos/pages, appends typed action-command nodes to event chains, and builds resource paths. Reentrancy is guarded by a parse-depth counter at this+0x194 shared by all four methods.

classes.name: UIWidgetFactory
classes.responsibility: Creates UI widgets by name: reuses an existing widget from the child container or constructs one of 23 keyword-table widget types through per-index constructors (228..772 bytes), installing dedicated vtables on some types, and applying a prelink-gizmo label to new widgets.

classes.name: UIWidgetRegistry
classes.responsibility: Searches a two-level nested linked list of named UI widgets, returning the last item whose name matches the query.

classes.name: UISessionPageDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Selects the UI page to open from the global session-mode value and the module-manager multiplayer state, routing all lookups through the dispatch interface.

classes.name: GameWindowManager
classes.responsibility: Creates and destroys the main game windows: registers/unregisters the cube-realtime window class and an optional message-window class, formats the title, creates the windows into the global handles, and manages cursor clipping. All state is in process globals rather than a this-object.

classes.name: GameFilePathBuilder
classes.responsibility: Free-standing file path construction helpers that produce player files ('.PLR') and settings files ('.vcr'), selecting the current directory with a default-path fallback.

classes.name: DualListRebuilder
classes.responsibility: Rebuilds a target list by transferring nodes from a source list: search/unlink/free and prepend fresh 12-byte nodes carrying the same data pointers, maintaining head/tail/anchor/count fields on both lists.

classes.name: RenderDeviceFieldsAccessor
classes.responsibility: Reads two DWORD fields from the global render-device object into caller-supplied outputs and returns the global pointer. Field meaning as viewport/surface dimensions is carried from existing analysis only.

classes.name: HUDWarningIconComposer
classes.responsibility: Queries three warning conditions (general, fuel/low-fuel, two-state indicator) and composes a short icon string rendered with scale into the scene.

classes.name: UIElementDispatchGroup
classes.responsibility: Dispatches a float value to each sub-element in an array of 748-byte-stride elements, gated by the element count field.

classes.name: TextureVariantLoader
classes.responsibility: Builds up to four texture-variant paths with a letter suffix (A..D), splitting the base name from its extension and defaulting the extension when absent, and registers each variant with the texture adjuster.

classes.name: OscillationSampleBuilder
classes.responsibility: Rebuilds a linked list of oscillation samples driven by clamped random-noise and sinusoidal motion, storing per-node float outputs and a next link; terminates when accumulated time exceeds a threshold.

states.name: INVALID_MODE
states.description: The session mode value at dword_7D0410 is not positive; no page is opened.

states.name: MONITOR_PAGE
states.description: The session mode value is 1..4; the monitor page is opened through the dispatch interface.

states.name: MULTIPLAYER_HOST_GRID
states.description: The session mode value is 5 and the module-manager state check selects the host; the multiplayer host grid page is opened.

states.name: MULTIPLAYER_CLIENT_GRID
states.description: The session mode value is 5 and the state check does not select the host; the multiplayer client grid page is opened.

transitions.trigger: dword_7D0410 == 5 and StateCheckWrapper(dword_7CD25C) does not select host

interfaces.name: UITokenReader
interfaces.purpose: Per-iteration token reader for UI definition parsing: yields the next definition token and, combined with the end-marker string compare, terminates parse loops.

interfaces.name: UIStringCompare
interfaces.purpose: String classification and keyword lookup used to identify definition tokens, command keywords and widget names.

interfaces.name: UIEventReport
interfaces.purpose: Reports parsing errors (formatted into byte_7CDCF0) and applies labels to created objects.

interfaces.name: GizmoResolver
interfaces.purpose: Resolves a gizmo token to a reusable widget object for prelinking into layers and elements.

interfaces.name: UIPageDispatcher
interfaces.purpose: Looks up and opens named UI pages through the dispatch interface pointer at dword_7CD8C0.

interfaces.name: TextureLoader
interfaces.purpose: Loads texture surfaces for UI elements and registers texture variants for adjustment.

interfaces.name: UITextRenderer
interfaces.purpose: Renders text with scale and color into the scene (HUD warnings).

interfaces.name: MemoryAllocator
interfaces.purpose: Allocates and frees node, layer and widget buffers (operator new wrappers and free wrappers).

interfaces.name: StringFormatService
interfaces.purpose: Formats strings into buffers (with overflow checks) and writes strings into IO streams.

interfaces.name: StringTokenUtilities
interfaces.purpose: String copy/realloc, character search, token splitting and normalization helpers used while parsing tokens and building paths.

interfaces.name: MultiplayerStateCheck
interfaces.purpose: Queries the module-manager multiplayer state to choose between the host and client grid pages.

interfaces.name: HudWarningState
interfaces.purpose: Provides the three HUD warning indicator states consumed by the warning-icon composer.

compatibility_contracts.name: ui_layer_definition_grammar
compatibility_contracts.description: A layer definition stream must be parseable as: a layer name classified against the normal/modal literals (unknown types format 'undefined layer type %s' into byte_7CDCF0 and are reported), followed by child tokens name (path-resolved when the parser write flag is set and the path depth is below 4), sound focus / sound lost focus (copied into the layer at byte offsets 108 and 148 and texture-loaded), gizmo (prelinked) and page. The token stream terminates at the asc_5CC4F4 end-marker.

compatibility_contracts.name: ui_action_command_grammar
compatibility_contracts.description: Action commands are 28-byte nodes tagged with a type 1..12 (DoPage 1, DoPageTransition variants 2..6, DoLayer 7, SetSymbol 9, DropPopups 10, ExitGame 11, SimulateClick 12) holding a copy of the token string, appended to the event action chain selected by the Click/Release/Focus/Lostfocus trigger keyword matched against the event spec.

compatibility_contracts.name: ui_widget_keyword_table
compatibility_contracts.description: A 23-entry keyword table off_5CC270 maps widget names to per-index construction paths (allocations of 228..772 bytes and type-specific constructors, with dedicated vtables on some indices); index 14 produces no widget and construction fails for it. Widget creation is a lookup-then-create protocol against the child container.

compatibility_contracts.name: resource_path_construction
compatibility_contracts.description: Resource paths are built into a 256-byte buffer by repeating the directory prefix word_5C406C (word_5C32D8 beyond four repeats) four-times-per-nesting-depth, appending the filename and the two-byte terminator word_5C30B4; when the write-mode flag is set and the write stream exists the path is written via StringFormatWithNestedIO.

compatibility_contracts.name: player_and_settings_file_extensions
compatibility_contracts.description: Player files are built by normalizing/re-appending the player name and appending the '.PLR' extension; settings/stream paths select the current directory (falling back to the default application path) and append the '.vcr' extension.

compatibility_contracts.name: game_window_lifecycle
compatibility_contracts.description: Window creation registers the 'CubeRealTime' window class (and an optional ClassName message-window class), creates the window(s) into the globals at 0x7CE2DC/0x7CE2E0, clips the cursor and shows the window. Shutdown destroys and unregisters both windows, guarding the equal-handle double-destroy case, and releases the cursor clip. Class registration failures abort with a non-zero result.

compatibility_contracts.name: session_mode_page_mapping
compatibility_contracts.description: A session mode value at dword_7D0410 of 1..4 opens the monitor page; a value of 5 opens either the multiplayer host grid or client grid page depending on the module-manager state check. All page opens go through the dispatch interface at dword_7CD8C0 with a -1 flag.

compatibility_contracts.name: oscillation_sample_format
compatibility_contracts.description: Oscillation samples are 16-byte linked-list nodes: node+4 holds the vertical amplitude output, node+8 the clamped (0.0..1.0) lateral snap output (snapped to 0.625/0.6 within a narrow band), node+12 the next link, and the head data slot accumulates time; list building stops when the accumulated time exceeds the threshold argument.

unresolved: buildOscillationSampleList has a direct ABI conflict: its ABI lead names Rain_Drop_Spray_Particle_Generator (LEGACY) while existing analysis labels it CameraOscillationGenerator; the packet cannot decide whether the sample list drives rain spray or camera sway.

The owner object of UIElementParser (this+0x194 depth, this+0x19A flag, this+0x19C depth, this+0x1A8 layer, this+0x1AC node, this+0x14 chain tail, this+0x4 write stream) is never identified; every function owner is UnknownObject in the packet. Class membership is inferred from the shared field offsets plus the direct caller link 0x00492460 -> 0x00492710.
The token buffer writes at layer byte offsets 108 and 148 are decompiler pointer arithmetic; the exact field semantics of those two strings are unknown.
The semantics of the action-command node type tags 1..12 beyond command identity are unknown; the 28-byte / 7-field sentinel node layout is not further interpreted.
The semantics of the widget field at byte offset 140 (non-zero suppresses the prelink label) and of the color-like constants 3289650 / 789516 at widget byte offsets 228 and 232 are unknown.
Keyword index 14 in the widget table has no switch case and produces no widget; the reason is unresolved.
The exact stream/token framing protocol of sub_491FB0 is not evidenced in the packet; loop termination and token framing semantics are DERIVED.
unk_7CD9D8 appears in the packet global table but is not referenced by any visible raw source; its role is unaccounted for.
The relationship between the parser depth counter at this+0x194 and callers' reentrancy guarantees is unresolved.
The meaning of the -51331646 sentinel written to DualListRebuilder this+0x30 and of the per-node flag byte at node+8 that gates the data-buffer free are unknown.
The exact visual/modal role of the secondary message window created in the message-window mode path is inferred, not confirmed.

The role of the read-only constants dword_8B8DC8+28 / +32 as viewport or render-surface dimensions comes only from existing analysis; the raw source proves only two unconditional reads of an unvalidated global pointer.
The mapping of individual read-only constant-pool globals (flt_59E*, flt_5AD*) to the specific arithmetic literals in the oscillation math is not established from this packet alone.
The exact pairing of the format-string globals aSS/aSC/aSCS with the '%s%c%s' / '%s%s' / '%s%c' literals in TextureVariantPathBuilder is inferred, not directly evidenced.
The on-screen meaning of the four warning icon bytes (-126, 68, -116, -115) and of the two state codes (1 and 2) in UIMessageCompose is DERIVED from existing analysis only.
Sub-element layout behind UIElementMultiDispatch (748-byte stride array at this[747]) and the effect of sub_4DF030 on each element are unknown.
